meta.name: keep-segment
meta.description: Customer segmentation model builder — tiers customers by ARR, health, and expansion potential; defines CS motion per tier; maps resource allocation. Use when asked to "segment our customers", "define our CS tiers", "how should we allocate CS resources", "build a customer segmentation model", or "who gets high-touch vs. digital".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据ARR和健康度对客户分层，定义服务策略与资源分配。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要按客户价值决定高触达还是数字化服务。
copy.tagline_en: Tier customers by ARR and health, define CS motions and allocate resources.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to decide high-touch vs. digital service based on customer value.

howto.what: 装上后，当被要求对客户分层、定义客户成功层级或分配CS资源时，Claude会根据年经常性收入（ARR）、健康度和扩展潜力将客户分为战略、增长、规模、长尾四层，并为每层定义客户成功策略（如接触频率、渠道、手册）和资源分配模型。
howto.when: 当用户说“对我们的客户进行分层”、“定义CS层级”或“如何分配CS资源”等类似要求时触发。

say.text: 请对我的客户进行分层。
say.note: Claude会询问总客户数、ARR分布等信息后输出分层框架。
Claude会给出每层的CS运动、配比和升级规则。

say.text: 哪些客户应该获得高接触服务？
say.note: Claude会根据阈值和规则判断哪些客户属于战略层。

howto.what_en: When asked to segment customers, define CS tiers, or allocate resources, Claude tiers customers by ARR, health, and expansion potential into Strategic, Growth, Scale, and Long Tail, then defines CS motion (cadence, channels, playbooks) and resource allocation per tier.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user says 'segment our customers', 'define our CS tiers', 'how should we allocate CS resources', or similar phrases.

say_en.text: Define CS tiers for different customers.
say_en.note: Claude will specify CS motion, ratio, and promotion rules per tier.
Claude will identify Strategic tier based on thresholds and rules.
